minutes.summary: The board accepted a de minimis site plan change at the Unitil building and released an old subdivision covenant off Northfield Road on condition the owner requests rescission and pays advertising. what_happened.line: The board released an old subdivision covenant off Northfield Road on condition that the owner requests rescission of the subdivision and pays advertising costs.
A public hearing on the rescission is to be advertised for February 12th.
The board accepted a de minimis change to the approved site plan at the Unitil building.
Staff are to draft sign bylaw changes allowing a pre-approved standard sign, after a resident asked for relief for small business signs.
A workshop on definitions and the use table is set for January 29th; the planner is to write up Wayland overlay wording changes for next week.

why_it_matters: Sign rules and the use table decide what small businesses may put up and where, so the drafts could change what a local business needs to get approved.
The covenant release and rescission hearing affect how an older subdivision off Northfield Road may be treated, and the hearing is open to the public.
watch_next: Workshop on January 29th on definitions and the use table.
Public hearing on the rescission, to be advertised for February 12th.
